To get straight to the point, all the menus I've eaten so far are delicious.
Sep 2026 • Family
I visited Song Vien during my trip to Da Nang!
To get straight to the point, all the menus I've eaten so far are delicious 👍
The seafood is generally fresh, and the shrimp in particular is plump and sweet, so it's delicious. The oyster is large and plump, and it's savory and delicious with plenty of garlic and peanuts on top.

The Vietnamese spring rolls have large shrimp in them, and eating them with vegetables is so clean that I keep reaching for more. If you like seafood, I think you will be satisfied.

I came here wanting to eat seafood in Da Nang, and so far, all the dishes I've ordered have been satisfying without any failures! 😋 The staff are friendly and the food comes out well, so I'm having a pleasant meal.
I recommend it for those looking for seafood restaurants in Da Nang. I want to revisit!
